g.text: Points: probe seeds 42-46. Bars next to points: mean ± SD over seeds (ours). Paper: mean ± SEM over pretraining seeds (a different source of variance).
Dotted line: paper value. Dashed line: chance. Panels follow the protocol order; the order does not rank the splits.
